description: "Other Tales and Sketches by Nathaniel Hawthorne" is a collection of literary works that includes various essays and short stories authored by Nathaniel Hawthorne, a prominent American writer of the 19th century. Written during the early to mid-19th century, this collection reflects themes common to the Romantic period, where the romantic idealism often intersects with darker elements of human experience.
